_warning: SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE — NOT REAL FRED DATA. These values were invented so that expected results are exact and hand-checkable. They must never be presented as observed data.
series_name: Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers: All Items, not seasonally adjusted (synthetic stand-in)

_designed_so_that.note: 14 observations: the documented minimum history for a year-over-year comparison plus its prior month. Only positions t, t-1, t-12 and t-13 enter the calculation.
_designed_so_that.why_not_seasonally_adjusted: The headline twelve-month CPI figure is conventionally computed from the NSA index. A twelve-month comparison already spans a full seasonal cycle, so adjustment is unnecessary. The intra-year values below deliberately wiggle rather than rising monotonically, as a real NSA index does; the twelve-month comparison is unaffected by that seasonality.
_designed_so_that.do_not: This series is an index level. It is never itself an inflation rate, and it must not be used for month-over-month inflation, which does require seasonal adjustment.
